postToolUse.notes: May settle a review cycle when Task returns without subagentStop; same id dedup as subagentStart.

subagent_id.required_for_review_lite: stable_id_fields only; bare top-level id uses strict multiset

fork_context.notes: Explicit true blocks independent reviewer evidence. Missing field: see ROUTER_RS_REVIEW_FORK_CONTEXT_MISSING_INFER_FALSE (unset=off; legacy host env only when explicitly enabled).

completion_signals.subagent_stop: qualifying subagentStop with matching cycle key
completion_signals.post_tool_settle: qualifying postToolUse return settles one pending cycle key
completion_signals.stop_satisfaction: independent_reviewer_seen via core-policy review_gate_blocks_stop; multiset/phase retained for compact bump and observation only

review_lite.fallback: strict when cycle key is not id: or qualifying fork/lane fails

wave2_requires_live_evidence.excludes: compact bump alone without live subagent evidence; Stop hard gate uses independent_reviewer_seen (Claude model)
